metaDescription: Order custom poly propylene caps in bulk. Durable, lightweight, and ideal for events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Poly propylene caps offer a lightweight yet durable option for outdoor events and giveaways. Unlike cotton or polyester, this material resists moisture and holds its shape in humid conditions, making it a practical choice for trade shows or company picnics. Custom embroidery or screen printing adheres well to the smooth surface, ensuring your logo stays sharp. These caps are also budget-friendly for large orders, so you can outfit your entire team or distribute at a conference without stretching your marketing budget.
